# UNPLUG LABS® OFFLINE OS

> A real Android launcher designed to help people use their phones intentionally.

Canonical website: https://YOUR-OFFLINE-OS-DOMAIN.vercel.app/
Current version: 1.0.0
Android package: com.unpluglabs.offlineos
Minimum target: Android 7.0+ (API 24)

## Core product
- Real Android Home/Launcher application.
- Not a website wrapper and not a replacement operating system.
- Focuses on intentional phone use, communication, app access, limits, timers, and focus.

## Key capabilities
- Android Home role / launcher behavior.
- Installed-app discovery, search, and launching.
- Notification inbox using Android notification access when authorized.
- Reply from launcher only when the originating notification exposes a supported reply action.
- App usage and limits using Android-supported usage information.
- Focus sessions.
- Device timer with actual device locking only when the required Android capability is explicitly enabled.
- Today's Message.
- Optional UNPLUG LABS experiences: THE READ, DROPS, LAB.

## Principles
- User control before automation.
- Local-first core functionality.
- No fake psychological diagnosis.
- No fake security, legal, or performance claims.
- No hidden surveillance.
